title: ui: the permission-set pages send the holder's package to the grant, clone and activation doors
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaP1iy4RSEQbW6177G

立卡门 ① · 已落地工作欠的后续：#32164 P2（PR #32306）契约审查 6813617327 ③ 与 step 0 6769973229 §3 点名的 UI 余项。Part of #31527 (ADR-0150)。Blocked-by #32306. Blocks #31698 PR-2.

## What

After PR #32306, the three permission-set doors take the holder's package: the grant through the stored column `permission_set_package`, clone and activation through `?package=PKG`. A name two packages hold answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with structured `candidates` when no package is named. The Console still sends the bare name everywhere, so once #31698 PR-2 lets a second package hold a name, an administrator cannot grant, clone or switch that set from the Console.

Callers (step 0 6769973229 §3):
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AssignedUsersSection.tsx`: ADD writes `{ user_id, permission_set }`; its list reads grants by `{ permission_set: name }`, so one set's page lists both holders' grants.
- `…/metadata-admin/permission-set-clone.ts`: `POST …/clone` names no source package.
- `…/metadata-admin/catalog-activation.ts`: `POST /security/_activation/:type/:name`, and its `sys_metadata_activation` read is keyed by `(metadata_type, name)` only.
- Read-only by name, same card: `catalog-holders.ts`, and the `permission-ref` widget (`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/RegistryRefField.tsx`).

## Acceptance

- Each write door sends the holder's package the page already holds; each list and ledger read is keyed by `(package, name)`.
- A `409` with `candidates` is shown as a pick among the named holders, never resolved by order.
- One holder: every request and screen is unchanged (CONTROL).
- Uses existing generic blocks and the doors' spec contract only; no new product-named widget.

## 业务理由

谁受益：管理员在装了两个同名权限集的包的环境里。场景：#31698 PR-2 后两个包都带 `sales_rep` 权限集。不做：Console 里对该权限集的授予、克隆、启停全部 409，管理员只能走 API。

## 读者

`domain:ui` 车道，#32306 合并后、#31698 PR-2 合并前；起点上列四个文件。

## 查重

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue AssignedUsersSection permission_set_package` → 1 hit (#32164 itself); `… permission_set_package Console clone activation package` → 1 hit (#32164). No duplicate.


Blocked-by: #32306
